unit: retrospective audited task case; tags non-exclusive

audit_selection_rule.BixBench-Verified-50: census: task with at least one rejected run in any archived configuration
audit_selection_rule.CompBioBench: census: task with at least one run deviating from the reconstructed key in any archived configuration
audit_selection_rule.IWC: IWC workflow with a low-agreement run, or near-perfect agreement concealing a changed result

census_check: Every BixBench/CompBio task with a rejected primary run is audited; the BixBench audit equals the set of tasks with a rejected run in any archived configuration.
annotation_status: AI-assisted retrospective audit; independent blinded expert adjudication has not been performed
population_prevalence_estimated: Task-level census of failing binary-benchmark tasks; not a run-level prevalence and not independently adjudicated

selected_cases.mechanism: A header filter also dropped valid chromosome identifiers
selected_cases.recorded_evidence: A digits-only regex precedes an inner join; the run explicitly accepts 18 rows although its input has 20 chromosome groups.
selected_cases.validation_opportunity: Assert preservation of eligible chromosome identifiers and row counts across the join.
selected_cases.contrasting_run: Luna Galaxy r1 explicitly asserts 20 rows and retains W and Z.
selected_cases.count_definition: One scored-incorrect primary run with traced row loss; not a validation-absence rate.
selected_cases.caveat: Tool binding matched the request; scientific correctness depends on the requested filter.

selected_cases.mechanism: Read-end artifacts were interpreted as a biological allele
selected_cases.recorded_evidence: Wrong-run exemplars report the pileup-based genotype; correct Sol runs record a read-position hypothesis and a Galaxy UDT that removes the apparent alternate signal.
selected_cases.validation_opportunity: Inspect allele support by read cycle and alignment end, rather than base quality alone.
selected_cases.contrasting_run: Sol Galaxy r2/r3 execute a read-position audit inside Galaxy.
selected_cases.count_definition: Twenty primary wrong calls attributed to the artifact by the targeted audit; this does not certify that all 20 omitted every validation step.
selected_cases.caveat: Domain judgment and validation rigor overlap; successful diagnostic use by Sol does not test the knowledge of other configurations.

selected_cases.recorded_evidence: GPT-5.5 code r1 first fits a held-out classifier, then replaces it with training-set estimates; GPT-5.5 Galaxy r1 fits and scores its estimators on the same reference reads.
selected_cases.validation_opportunity: Use grouped held-out or cross-fitted estimates and challenge perfect training separation.
selected_cases.contrasting_run: Sol Galaxy r2 explicitly prevents identical reads from leaking between training and validation folds.
selected_cases.count_definition: Two runs with in-sample leakage in the audit: one code and one Galaxy. A third wrong run follows a UDT outage and a different route.
selected_cases.caveat: The leakage mechanism is observed across both arms; the third wrong run is not counted as the same mechanism.

selected_cases.mechanism: Structural plausibility or self-mapping was treated as sequence identity
selected_cases.recorded_evidence: A Galaxy run explicitly selects a circular, high-depth contig; a code run explicitly validates a seed by mapping reads back to that same seed. The three zero-score outputs share no canonical 31-mers with the workflow reference.
selected_cases.validation_opportunity: Test mitochondrial gene content or independent organellar identity, alongside structure, coverage and read support.
selected_cases.contrasting_run: Successful Galaxy runs use the MitoHiFi reference-finding and assembly route.
selected_cases.count_definition: Three zero-agreement candidates, one Galaxy and two code, attributed to non-mitochondrial candidate selection in the targeted audit.
selected_cases.caveat: The input-only policy conflicted with external-reference requirements. Some recorded validation was performed but did not establish molecular identity.

selected_cases.mechanism: A direct cross-check contradicted the candidate identity but was not acted on
selected_cases.recorded_evidence: DeepSeek Galaxy r1 calls ENCODE peak-set overlap a direct identity check; its returned Jaccard values are approximately 0.0011 and 0.0006, yet it retains one of those candidates.
selected_cases.validation_opportunity: Treat negative candidate tests as reasons to broaden hypotheses and examine independent read-level evidence.
selected_cases.contrasting_run: GPT-5.5 Galaxy r1 computes read-level promoter, gene-body and repeat enrichment with UDT jobs.
selected_cases.count_definition: One direct ignored-cross-check example among two wrong DeepSeek Galaxy runs. The second has no reasoning transcript and is not counted as positive ignored-check evidence.
selected_cases.caveat: The audit also assigns domain-knowledge error. Weak overlap is evidence against the chosen candidate, not an independently definitive histone identity test.

replicate_pattern_interpretation.one_or_two_wrong: Observed within-cell outcome variability; mostly agent-analysis tasks, and nearly all Galaxy platform/wrapper tasks fall here.
replicate_pattern_interpretation.three_wrong: Observed repeated rejection; enriched for benchmark, reference or provenance categories relative to sporadic failures. The count alone does not assign a cause.
replicate_pattern_interpretation.scored_wrong_not_scientifically_wrong: Reference and evaluator defects must be separated from agent failure.
